prompt: Who was the first person to be an American diplomatic minister to Romania and Serbia?
answer: **Eugene Schuyler** was the first American diplomatic minister to both **Romania and Serbia**. He was appointed **Minister Resident and Consul General** in 1882, presenting his credentials in Romania on September 8 and in Serbia on November 10. His residence was in Athens, as he was also accredited to Greece.
